full_judgment: 2. Short fact relevant for the purpose of the case are that opposite party No. 1 as plaintiff instituted a suit in the 3rd Court of the Subordinate Judge, Dhaka being Title Suit No.374 of 1984, which was subsequently re-numbered as Title Suit No.258 of 1992, praying for declaration of title and recovery of the Khas possession in the suit property alleging, inter alia that the suit land along with other lands originally belonged to Naik Goala and accordingly, the CS record was prepared in his name. In course of time the entire land was purchased by one Hariram Dhar in an auction sale about 60 years ago and since then he had been owning and possessing the same. Subsequently, the said Hariram concluded an amicable family settlement dated 20-4-1928 by a registered instrument in respect to the suit property along with the other lands following which his wife Sukumari Dhar and 5 sons and daughter Rani Bhabani Sen got the suit property in their exclusive shares and by mutual arrangement the suit land fell in the share of Sukumari Dhar. Thereafter, Sukumari Dhar transferred the suit land to her two sons Anil Chandra Dhar and Nihar Chandra Dhar by a registered sale deed dated 19-6-1944 and delivered possession to them. Subsequently, Anil Chandra Dhar gifted his 8 an has share to his wife Minoti Rani Dhar by a registered deed of gift dated 6-7-1945 and duly delivered possession to her. Thereafter, Minoti Rani and Nihar Ranjan Dhar transferred decimals of land from the suit plot by its eastern side to Indu Mia and Shajjadi Bibi by three sale deeds in the year 1949 and delivered (8) possession to the transferees. While being in rightful possession the said Indu Mia and Shajjadi Bibi settled the suit land to the plaintiffs father Abu Bakar Mohammad Awal by a registered deed of lease dated 25-11-90 and delivered possession to the lessee and the plaintiff in due course of time inherited the suit land as a daughter of Abu Bakar Awal and owned and possessed the same. The defendants having no title and possession in the said land illegally dispossessed the plaintiff on 18-11-1984 and hence the suit.
